translationRepairs: Seven years later, in the sixth month, Emperor Wen passed away.
In the seventh year of the Later era, in the sixth month, Emperor Wen passed away.
後七年 here is the seventh year of Emperor Wen's Later era (后元), not an elapsed span after a prior event; the proposed wording restores that reign-year sense and matches 六月，文帝崩.
Judge Hui Shuo and his wives and children according to the law.'
Sentence Hui Shuo and his wives and children according to the law.'

論...如法 is a legal imperative to sentence the offenders, so sentence-initial 'Judge' wrongly invites a title reading; the proposal's verb is right, but the closing edict quote mark after 如法 must be kept.
